values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/hollandlake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Holland Lake State Forest Campground, Luce: 15 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in paddling access about 30 yards from the parking area.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/hollandlake ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'Carry-in access is located approximately 30 yards from the parking area.'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/hollandlake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table (Holland Lake: 'Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 15 'tent and small trailer sites' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/hollandlake ('Featuring 15 tent and small trailer sites'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (15 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on Holland Lake (a dammed flowage; brook trout), 25 mi NW of Newberry via M-123 and County Roads 407 and 426, Luce County; managed by Muskallonge Lake State Park. A base for ORV riders: direct access to the Pine Ridge Trail, which connects to the Two Heart Trail (riding allowed from campsites to the trails only), and snowmobile Trail #8. Hilly terrain, so leveling a larger rig can be a project. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 15 tent/small-trailer sites, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed).
